issue.title: tui: disable BCE almost always

repository.name: neovim
repository.description: Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability

issue.body:
Update: ef195e8 _always_ disables BCE except for "real xterm". 

Summary:

- Nvim 0.2.0 did not implement BCE. 
- Nvim 0.2.1 enabled BCE aggressively.
- Nvim 0.2.3+ (after this PR) disables BCE (like 0.2.0) in all cases except when the `$XTERM_VERSION` env var is defined.
